info.title: Droplet Projects API
info.description:
The native Projects (work tracking) API of a Droplet box, under `/api/pm`.

**Authentication.** Scripts use a personal API token: create one in the dashboard under Settings -> Developer (an owner or admin must first allow API tokens), then send `Authorization: Bearer dpm_...`. A token is shown once. It acts as the person who created it, so it can never do more than that person's role allows; its scopes only narrow it: `pm:read` for GET requests, `pm:write` for everything else (write implies read). A token works only on `/api/pm` and `/api/support`, and not on admin configuration there (webhooks, project and desk settings), which needs a dashboard session. A POST that only reads (a filter too large for a query string, such as the work-item query) needs just `pm:read`, and says so in its `security`. It stops working when the person is deactivated or their role changes, when it expires, or when it is revoked.

**Errors.** Every error is JSON with an `error` field. 401: the token is invalid, revoked, expired, or API tokens are switched off. 403: the role or the scope does not permit it. 404: the row is missing, or the Projects module is off. 429: over the limit of 300 requests a minute per token.

**Dates.** `dueDate` and `startDate` are calendar dates stored at 00:00:00Z.

get.description: Active projects, open items, items done in the last 7 days and overdue items. Any member, admin or owner.
Archived projects are left out unless `archived` is `1` or `true`. Any member, admin or owner.

post.description: Creates the project with the default states (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, Done, Cancelled). Owner, admin or member.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change; `null` clears a nullable field. Owner, admin or member.

delete.description: Deletes the project with all its work items. Owner, admin or member.

patch.description: Changing the group re-syncs the completion flag of the items in it. Owner, admin or member.

delete.description: The last state and the only default state cannot be deleted (409). Its items move to the default state. Owner, admin or member.

get.description: Archived items are left out. Ordered by `sortOrder`, then `sequenceId`. Any member, admin or owner.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: A state id, slug or name.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A parent work item id, or `none` for top-level items.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text over the name and description.

post.description: Numbered in the project (`KEY-n`). Owner, admin or member.

get.summary: Work items assigned to the caller
get.description: Across projects, newest change first. Any member, admin or owner.
Free text over name and description, newest change first. With no `q` and no `department` the result is empty. Any member, admin or owner.
With its relations alongside. Any member, admin or owner.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change; `null` clears a nullable field. Owner, admin or member.

delete.description: Sub-items are promoted to top level. Owner, admin or member.

post.summary: Move a work item to a state
post.description: Owner, admin or member. The state must belong to the item's project.

get.description: Oldest to newest. Any member, admin or owner.

post.description: Across projects is allowed. A `BLOCKS` link that would close a cycle is a 409. Owner, admin or member.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The work item the link starts from.

delete.description: By the id either end returns. Owner, admin or member.

get.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 description of /api/pm. Any member, admin or owner.
Read the scheduled work items, blocking relations, and module milestones in a bounded date window. The inclusive window may span at most 1100 days.
Read the signed-in person’s work across projects. The person is taken from the credential; query parameters cannot select another person.

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: The viewer’s calendar date; defaults to the server’s UTC date.

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token, created in the dashboard under Settings -> Developer and shown once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer dpm_...`. Scopes: `pm:read` (GET requests) and `pm:write` (everything else; implies read).

sessionCookie.name: droplet_session
sessionCookie.description: The dashboard's own session. Not for scripts.

Workspace.name: workspace
Workspace.description: A workspace slug. Defaults to the home workspace.

Department.name: department
Department.description: A department or team id, slug or name (a department includes its teams), or `none` for work no department owns. An unknown value is a 404.

InvalidRequest.description: The request body or query did not validate.

Unauthorized.description: No credential, or the token is invalid, revoked, expired, or API tokens are switched off by an admin (`code`: `TOKEN_INVALID`, `TOKEN_REVOKED`, `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, `TOKEN_DISABLED`).

Forbidden.description: The caller's role does not permit this, or the token lacks the scope (`{ "error": "insufficient_scope", "required": "pm:write" }`).

NotFound.description: The named row does not exist (`<thing>_not_found`), or the Projects module is switched off (`module_disabled`), or the caller's role may not open Projects.

Conflict.description: The request is well-formed but the current state forbids it (`identifier_taken`, `state_is_last`, `state_is_default`, `department_archived`, `relation_exists`, `relation_cycle`, `relation_scan_exhausted`, `concurrent_mutation`).

Unprocessable.description: The referenced row exists but the choice is not allowed (`invalid_parent`, `invalid_state`, `invalid_label`, `department_not_assignable`, `lead_is_guest`, `relation_self`).

TooManyRequests.description: Over the rate limit. An API token may make 300 requests a minute. `RateLimit` headers say when to retry.

source.description: `item` when the work item names its own department, `project` when it inherits its project's.

StateGroup.description: The kanban-column semantics of a state.

identifier.description: The key prefix of the project's work items, e.g. `INBOX` in `INBOX-42`.

companyId.description: The customer this project is for (CRM company id).

openCount.description: Non-terminal items. Present on list responses.

doneCount.description: Items in a completed state. Present on list responses.

isDefault.description: The landing state for new work items. Exactly one per project.

sequenceId.description: The number part of the key.

authorId.description: `null` for a system or assistant comment.

actorId.description: `null` for the system or the assistant.

id.description: Delete a relation by this id, from either end.

direction.description: `blocks`: the item you asked about blocks the other end. `blocked_by`: the reverse. `symmetric`: RELATES and DUPLICATES.

identifier.description: Derived from the name when omitted.

state_id.description: Defaults to the project's default state.

parent_id.description: Must be an item of the same project.

department_id.description: Overrides the project's department for this item.
`null` clears the override, so the item inherits its project's department again.
